notes: §1985:X.5.1 GR1: for a BY CONTENT parameter 'the value of the item is moved when the CALL statement is executed and placed into a system-defined storage item possessing the attributes declared in the Linkage Section'; the descriptions 'must be the same' is a requirement on the source with no prescribed reaction. CallBinder.BindCall records the BY CONTENT mode, CallEmitter.ArgCarrierText/CallContentRead snapshot the argument's value at the CALL into a detached cell, and ProgramEmitter.FormalCrossing lands it in the callee's formal, so a store into the formal never reaches the caller; at 85 Format1Narrowing refuses the 2002 literal, figurative and BY VALUE/OMITTED forms (COBOL0900). Probes: (d/f) S9(18) -999999999999999999, S9(18) COMP-3, numeric-edited, zero, an ODO group and TE(I) with I passed BY REFERENCE and changed by the callee, each modified in the callee and unchanged in the caller (TE(I) delivered BBB, the value at CALL time); (b) BY CONTENT "ABC", 12, ZERO, BY VALUE, OMITTED, LENGTH OF and an empty BY CONTENT refused; (e) a failed CALL with BY CONTENT takes ON OVERFLOW. Sibling seen and already filed: BY CONTENT FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(W) is accepted at 85 against §1985:X.5.2.3 SR4 (kb/Work PB5129, a syntax-rule defect outside this rule). The witness prints AAAAA/BBBBB/AAAAA.

next.reason: 1985: a BY CONTENT value is 'placed into a system-defined storage item possessing the attributes declared in the Linkage Section', and each BY CONTENT parameter's description 'must be the same, meaning no conversion or extension or truncation'. §2023:14.2.3 GR9: for a plain CALL the allocated record 'is of the same length as the argument' and 'moved to this allocated record without conversion'; for a prototyped or NESTED call it has the formal parameter's description and is filled by COMPUTE, SET or MOVE. Conformance is looser: §2023:14.8.2.3.3 asks only that 'the formal parameter shall be of the same length as the corresponding argument' for an elementary item in a plain CALL (MOVE/COMPUTE rules otherwise), and §2023:14.8.2.2 SR2 applies MOVE rules to a group. §2023:13.7.3 SR3 and §2023:14.9.4.3 SR25 bind both sides to these rules, and §2023:14.9.4.4 GR3d makes a detected violation set EC-PROGRAM-ARG-MISMATCH (1985 stated only the requirement).
